text: My Amazon order hasnt arrived yet and its been 10 days. Can you help?
Hi! Sorry to hear your order is delayed. Please DM us your order number so we can look into this for you.
I want to return a defective product I received. How do I get a refund?
We're sorry about the defective item! Please go to Your Orders and select Return or Replace Items. A refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
I cant log into my Amazon account. I forgot my password.
No worries! Visit amazon.com/forgot-password and enter your email to reset your password. Check your inbox for the reset link.
Why was I charged twice for the same order?
We apologize for the inconvenience! A duplicate charge can happen but is usually reversed within 24-48 hours. Please DM us your order ID and well investigate right away.
The Amazon app keeps crashing on my iPhone whenever I try to checkout.
Sorry about the app issues! Try clearing the app cache or reinstalling the app. If the issue persists please DM us your device details.
I need to cancel my Prime subscription immediately.
You can cancel Prime anytime from Account and Lists > Prime Membership > End Membership. Let us know if you need help!
Is the Echo Dot compatible with Google Home devices?
The Echo Dot works with Alexa smart home devices but has limited native compatibility with Google Home. Check the product page for full compatibility details.
This is absolutely terrible service. My package was stolen and nobody is helping me.
We are so sorry to hear this. Stolen packages are a serious matter. Please DM us immediately so we can open an investigation and explore your options.
My order shows delivered but I never received it. Tracking says it was left at the door.
We are sorry about the missing package! Please wait 48 hours as sometimes packages are marked delivered early. If still missing DM us your order number.
I was charged $9.99 for a subscription I never signed up for.
We understand your concern! Unauthorized charges are taken very seriously. Please DM us your account details so we can investigate and process a refund if applicable.
Your website is showing an error 503 when I try to place an order.
We apologize for the technical issue! Our team is aware and working to resolve it. Please try again in 15 minutes or use the Amazon app as an alternative.
I want to cancel my order before it ships.
You can cancel your order from Your Orders if it hasnt shipped yet. If it has already shipped youll need to wait for delivery and then initiate a return.
When will the PlayStation 5 be back in stock on Amazon?
Stock availability changes frequently! We recommend turning on availability alerts on the product page to be notified as soon as it is back in stock.
I am very disappointed with Amazon. My refund has been pending for 2 weeks.
We apologize for the delay! Refunds typically process in 3-5 business days. Please DM us your refund ID so we can escalate this for you.
My password reset email never arrived. I checked spam folder.
Sorry about that! Try an alternate email or verify the correct email is on file. If issues persist please DM us and we will help you regain access.
The product I received is completely different from what I ordered.
We are sorry you received the wrong item! Please go to Your Orders and select Problem with Order to request a replacement or full refund.
I think my Amazon account was hacked. I see orders I didnt place.
This is very serious! Please change your password immediately and enable two-step verification. DM us right away so we can secure your account and investigate.
How long does standard shipping usually take?
Standard shipping typically takes 3-5 business days depending on your location. Prime members get free 2-day shipping on eligible items.
I got a bill for items I returned weeks ago. This is outrageous.
We sincerely apologize! A billing error after a return should not happen. Please DM us your order number and return tracking ID and we will resolve this immediately.
The Amazon Fire TV remote stopped working. Is this covered under warranty?
Amazon devices typically come with a one-year limited warranty. Please check your purchase date and visit the device warranty page or DM us for further assistance.
I keep getting an error when trying to add my credit card to my account.
Sorry about the payment error! Please ensure your billing address matches your bank records. If the issue persists try a different browser or clear your cookies.
My Amazon Fresh delivery arrived with spoiled produce. I want a refund.
That is completely unacceptable and we apologize! For spoiled grocery items please go to Your Orders > Problem with Order and select refund. Items will be refunded immediately.
I never authorized Amazon to charge my card for Prime. This is fraud.
We take unauthorized charge claims very seriously. Please DM us your account details so we can investigate this immediately and ensure your account is secure.
I want to know if the Kindle Paperwhite works without wifi.
Yes! The Kindle Paperwhite can store books and read them offline without wifi. You need wifi only to download new books or sync your library.
My subscription renewal failed and now I lost Prime benefits.
We are sorry about the failed renewal! Please update your payment method in Account Settings > Manage Prime. Your benefits should restore automatically once payment succeeds.
